# Marrow

> Marrow is a Manila streetwear label (est. 2018) that makes functional outerwear, heavyweight jersey and wide-leg bottoms in limited seasonal runs.

## Sections

- [Home](https://marrow-silk.vercel.app/): The Fall/Winter 2026 collection, the City Moves campaign, and shop-by-category navigation.
- [Shop](https://marrow-silk.vercel.app/shop): The full current range across outerwear, bottoms, tops, footwear and accessories.
- [Collections](https://marrow-silk.vercel.app/collections): Seasonal collections, including the Winter Drop.
- [About](https://marrow-silk.vercel.app/about): How Marrow started and what the label stands for.
- [Journal](https://marrow-silk.vercel.app/journal): Campaign stories and editorial from the streets.

## Key products — Fall/Winter 2026

- **Utility Hooded Jacket** — $128. Three-layer matte ripstop with taped seams. SKU MAR-OW-01.
- **Essential Crewneck** — $68. 480 gsm brushed loopback cotton. SKU MAR-TO-07.
- **Wide Leg Cargo Pants** — $98. Dry-touch cotton twill with six pockets. SKU MAR-BT-04.
- **Logo Cap** — $32. Washed cotton twill with an embroidered mark. SKU MAR-AC-02.

## Frequently asked questions

- **What does Marrow make?** Functional outerwear, heavyweight jersey tops and wide-leg bottoms, released in limited seasonal runs rather than continuous restocks.
- **Where is Marrow based?** Manila, Philippines. The label was founded there in 2018.
- **How often does Marrow release new pieces?** Twice a year for the main seasons, plus limited drops such as the Winter Drop.
- **What are the prices?** Current pieces range from $32 for accessories to $128 for outerwear.
- **How do I return an item?** Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery on unworn pieces with tags attached.
